summary:
Implemented the window title setting in the repository, but nothing has been run. Tests, Black and mypy were not executed, as the task required.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 after the existing values; ControlCode union now includes Tuple[ControlType, str].
- rich/control.py: added the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), which passes (ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE, title) as one argument.
- rich/console.py: added set_window_title(title) -> bool after show_cursor. It buffers the control and returns True when is_terminal, otherwise False.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: new elif branch calling term.set_title(title); LegacyWindowsTerm.set_title already existed.
- CHANGELOG.md: Unreleased > Added bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32) in tests/test_console.py; test_control_title in tests/test_control.py; test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only, mocked wrapper) in tests/test_windows_renderer.py.

Choices: title text is written unmodified; non-legacy output goes through the existing Segment.text path, so render paths needed no changes; the console test skips on sys.platform == "win32" rather than checking the legacy flag.

Outstanding: run the test suite, Black at 88 columns, and mypy to confirm.
